department: Department of Statistics and Actuarial Science

deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for September 2027 (Fall entry only).
deadline.quote: December 1 (for admission in September of the following year)

gre_general.value: No GRE is required; you may submit one if you have it.
gre_general.quote: No, none of our programs require a GRE test. If you have taken one you are welcome to submit it along with the required documentation.

gre_subject.value: No GRE subject test is required.
gre_subject.quote: No, none of our programs require a GRE test.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale, with 5 in writing and speaking.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with at least 6.5 in writing and speaking.

supervisor.value: You can apply without a supervisor, but a doctoral offer is conditional on arranging one; contact faculty before applying.
supervisor.quote: Doctoral applicants may find it helpful to speak with prospective supervisors prior to applying as acceptance is conditional on arranging a supervisor.

also.quote: Before applying to the program, students are strongly advised to establish contact with potential supervisors.

funding.value: Every full-time PhD student, international included, gets at least CAD 29,145 a year for four years; internationals also get an award covering the international tuition difference.
funding.quote: Full-time doctoral students (both domestic and international) receive minimum funding of $29,145 per year (effective May 1, 2026) for up to four years.

also.quote: International students in a full-time PhD program will be awarded an International Doctoral Student Award (IDSA)

entry_route.value: A master's in statistics, actuarial science or mathematics is the normal route; outstanding bachelor's graduates may apply directly.
entry_route.quote: A master's degree in statistics, actuarial science, or mathematics, completed or expected. | Students with an undergraduate degree in statistics, actuarial science, or mathematics may apply for admission directly to the PhD program.

notes: A Biostatistics PhD is offered as a separate option in the same department.
